newsitem.title: USA: AmeriCredit closes new credit facility.
newsitem.headline: AmeriCredit closes new credit facility.

text.p: AmeriCredit Corp said Friday it closed a new $75 million bank facility to fund loan originations in the company's new home equity lending subsidiary, which will operate under the name AmeriCredit Mortgage Services.
AmeriCredit Mortgage Services, formerly known as Rancho Vista Mortgage Corp, was acquired by the company in November 1996, AmeriCredit said.
The credit facility bears interest, based upon the company's option, at either the bank's prime lending rate or the London Interbank Offered Rate plus 1.25 percentage points, AmeriCredit said.
